description: Older way to start, kept for assistants that still use it: prefer find_templates and install_template, then find_hacks with the new trackId. Starts from the template the person's words match best ("track my Shopify orders"), or gives back their track on that topic when they have one (created is false). sources lists TrackerHacker's own sources the words named for it: turn one on with turn_on_ready_hack. With forSharing and a schemaId, it's how a template author starts a new, empty sheet to share. Tell the person every line of tell_the_person.

bare.description: With forSharing: only TrackerHacker's theme, without the starter's Start here, Settings and Glance tabs, for a minimal base.

forSharing.description: true makes a new, empty sheet on schemaId, with no hacks or links, to share with share_template: nothing of the person's can reach it.

schemaId.description: With forSharing: the topic of the template to make.

starter.description: A topic id (schemaId), for assistants that kept one: starts from the most copied template on that topic.

text.description: What the person wants to track, in their words.

name: start_tracking
title: Start from the person's words
